77 |  *
78 |  * 允许 AI 加载技能以获取特定任务的详细指导。

80 | export class SkillTool extends BaseTool<typeof parameters> {
81 |     name = 'skill';
82 |     description = '';
83 |     schema = parameters;
84 | 
85 |     /**
86 |      * 构造函数
87 |      *
88 |      * @param includeDescription - 是否包含详细描述（包含可用技能列表）

90 |     constructor(private includeDescription: boolean = true) {
91 |         super();
92 |         this.description = this.generateDescription();
93 |     }

96 |      * 生成工具描述
97 |      *
98 |      * 动态生成包含所有可用技能的描述。
99 |      */
100 |     private generateDescription(): string {
101 |         if (!this.includeDescription) {
102 |             return 'Load a skill to get detailed instructions for a specific task.';
103 |         }
104 | 
105 |         const loader = getSkillLoader();
106 |         const skills = loader.getAllMetadata();
107 | 
108 |         if (skills.length === 0) {
109 |             return 'Load a skill to get detailed instructions for a specific task. No skills are currently available.';
110 |         }
111 | 
112 |         const skillsList = skills.flatMap((skill) => [
113 |             '  <skill>',
114 |             `    <name>${skill.name}</name>`,
115 |             `    <description>${skill.description}</description>`,
116 |             '  </skill>',
117 |         ]);
118 | 
119 |         return [
120 |             'Load a skill to get detailed instructions for a specific task.',
121 |             'Skills provide specialized knowledge and step-by-step guidance.',
122 |             'Use this when a task matches an available skill\'s description.',
123 |             '<available_skills>',
124 |             ...skillsList,
125 |             '</available_skills>',
126 |         ].join(' ');
127 |     }

131 |      *
132 |      * @param args - 技能参数

134 |      */
135 |     async execute(args: z.infer<typeof parameters>): Promise<string> {
136 |         const loader = getSkillLoader();
137 |         const skill = loader.getSkill(args.name);
138 | 
139 |         // 技能不存在
140 |         if (!skill) {
141 |             const available = loader.getAllMetadata().map((s) => s.name).join(', ');
142 |             throw new Error(`Skill "${args.name}" not found. Available skills: ${available || 'none'}`);
143 |         }
144 | 
145 |         // 读取技能文件
146 |         try {
147 |             const content = await loader.readSkillFile(args.name, 'SKILL.md');
148 |             const parsed = parseSkillMarkdown(content, skill.metadata.path);
149 |             const dir = skill.metadata.path;
150 | 
151 |             // 格式化输出
152 |             const output = [`## Skill: ${skill.metadata.name}`, '', `**Base directory**: ${dir}`, '', parsed.trim()].join('\n');
153 | 
154 |             const result: SkillToolResult = {
155 |                 title: `Loaded skill: ${skill.metadata.name}`,
156 |                 output,
157 |                 metadata: {
158 |                     name: skill.metadata.name,
159 |                     dir,
160 |                 },
161 |             };
162 | 
163 |             return JSON.stringify(result, null, 2);
164 |         } catch (error) {
165 |             const errorMsg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
166 |             throw new Error(`Failed to load skill "${args.name}": ${errorMsg}`);
167 |         }
